'''Lilith''' is a NPC female student who is recruiting for the [[Fleet Snowfluff]] Fan Club. She can be found North-West of the Academy Square, facing towards the {{Rubi|Can & Tin|Eatery}}. 

==Location==

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Lilith:''' Come on, join our Fleet Snowfluff Fan Club!
:{{DIcon}} Fleet Snowfluff?
:'''Lilith:''' That's right. Have you heard [[Aemeath|her]] songs? Her style is all over the place. Super romantic one minute, and totally off-the-cuff the next.
:'''Lilith:''' But she hasn't released a new song in over ten years.
:'''Lilith:''' But even so, her songs have never gone out of style! You've gotta give them a listen!
{{Dialogue End}}
